description: Connecticut OEC active-center metadata and aggregate preflight only; no facility acquisition.

output_schema_contract.row_unit: source rows, not unique credentials or active businesses
output_schema_contract.address: address2 availability only; premises semantics not independently verified
output_schema_contract.coordinates: No coordinate fields selected or geocode inferred

redirect_policy: Fixed h8mr-dn95 catalog and active-center aggregate requests only; reject redirects and omit credentials.
retry: No automatic retries or endpoint fallback. Provider deferral and changed metadata/counts stop the preflight.
checkpoint: Persist only a complete validated immutable receipt. Retain selected schema and paired aggregates; discard catalog cached values before retention.
idempotency: New immutable UUID receipt per explicit successful publication. Never replace a source, enrollment or national pointer.
cancellation: Abort noncooperative headers/body and pacing; await local writers. Preserve uncertain postcommit publication for inspection rather than retry.
retention_profile: Internal metadata/count evidence, without contact/person samples, facility rows or record-level exports.
